actual_observations.build: Production socket-free parent and separate TEST_ONLY parent/unchanged UDP child compiled under retained warnings-as-errors.
actual_observations.normal: Held-child creation, resume, wait and report binding passed for before/sample/contained-phase/after. The main receiver verified and echoed 45 frames, including all 40 sampler indices and 3 contained-phase indices.
actual_observations.profile: TEST_ONLY profile-only path executed real hosted identity checks without child creation or sockets. Production was invoked only with invalid CLI.
actual_observations.injected_refusals: Token-query failure, SID mismatch and pre-resume failure were fixture injections. Each created a suspended child but did not resume it; owned held-handle termination and wait completed, and each respective responder observed 0 datagrams. The resume injection is not an actual failed ResumeThread API call.
actual_observations.actual_timeout: A sample child was resumed under an at-most 3000 ms parent cap. Its dedicated receiver verified and echoed 4 sample frames. The parent recorded timeout, exact-owned termination and a signaled child wait. No valid child report was observed, so 4 is receiver evidence, not a native accepted-send count. These receiver observations remain despite the expected timeout.
actual_observations.cleanup: All 10 parent processes exited without parent kills and their handles closed; all 5 responder sockets and threads closed. Parent-attested descendant cleanup and work removal were confirmed.

limits.identity: Hosted sid_matched denotes the non-AppContainer/null-SID pair,not observed AppContainer SID equality or PSEC inheritance.

limits.network: Contained is a fixture phase label,not an actual contained process. All actual network targets were owned hosted loopback. No production valid-network-CLI/nonadmin positive,guest runner egress,packet capture,DNS or broker result.
limits.runtime: No adapter/full Windows guest/VM or artifact upload was enabled by this short workflow. Existing UDP child/identity/policy and runtime files remained unchanged.
limits.acceptance: No AppContainer inheritance,packet absence,isolation,privacy,product or Linux-equivalence acceptance follows. Earlier actual TCP/UDP observations remain separately scoped.
